instructions: 核对并填写 anime_title、角色中文 name、traits（至少8项）和 description（100–200字中文）；不要编造资料。完成后用 --apply 写入。

characters.name: 成濑川奈留
characters.description: 成濑川奈留是一名十七岁的高中生，也是日向庄的住户。她学习成绩优秀，把考入东京大学作为目标，但面对突发状况时脾气火爆，经常用拳头教训惹出麻烦的景太郎。奈留最初把景太郎看作不可靠的成年考生，后来在共同生活和备考过程中逐渐理解他。她外表强势，内心重视伙伴与承诺，是日向庄群像中最重要的成员之一。
traits: 与浦岛景太郎共同生活
逐渐与景太郎建立感情

source.description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

Naru Narusegawa is a 17-year-old student and resident of the Hinata Inn that can be described as "one fuse short of a cannon" because of her extremely fiery temper and tendency to be very physical, mainly with Keitaro whenever she feels he's acting perverted. Of all the girls in the Hinata House, she is victimized the most by Keitaro's clumsiness which often results in her being naked, exposed in some fashion, or lying in very suggestive positions. Throughout most of high school she studied hard and became Tops in the nation on the college practice exams in order to get into Tokyo University. Because of her intense study regiment she became majorly short-sighted and has to wear thick "coke-bottle glasses" when not wearing her contacts.  

~! She developed feelings for Keitaro, however, was unable to admit it to herself or anyone else for a long time. Despite overcoming this and confessing her love, hitting Keitaro whenever he got "too close" had become involuntary and second nature.!~

characters.name: 青山素子
characters.description: 青山素子是十五岁的高中生，来自传承神鸣流剑术的青山家族。她日常举止正式严谨，把剑道训练看得十分重要，房间里也摆放着与武士修行有关的物品。素子搬入日向庄后，起初对男性和景太郎抱有戒心，之后逐渐与住户们建立信任。她尊敬姐姐鹤子，却也需要在家族传统和自己的选择之间找到方向。
traits: 以剑道训练和家族传统为重

source.description:
__Height__: 175cm (5'9")

Motoko Aoyama is a 15-year-old high school girl who is very formal and into kendo, to the point that her room resembles that of a samurai's (complete with a suit of armor). She claims lineage to a school of demonslaying swordsmen and also displays a prodigious competence with her katana. She can often wreak great damage to boulders or other objects using nothing more than her wooden practice sword. Motoko is very terrified of her sister, Tsuruko, whose skill far exceeds her own, and has a phobia of turtles that is left unexplained for the majority of the series. She disapproves of Keitaro early on, on the basis of him being a letch and a weakling, but later develops a grudging respect and eventually a hidden affection for him (much to her chagrin). She is at first uncomfortable with her femininity, partially because her sister left her sword for a husband, partially because of her height: she is the tallest person in the house, 3 cm taller than Keitaro (171cm). She later becomes more open due to Keitaro's influence. Whatever her feelings for Keitaro happen to be at a given time, she still frequently threatens or attacks him with her sword.

characters.name: 可萝拉·苏
characters.description: 可萝拉·苏是日向庄的住户，来自莫鲁莫鲁王国，性格活泼而富有创造力。她常把好奇心转化为各种发明和实验，给日向庄的日常带来意外状况。可萝拉与姐姐阿玛拉同属王族家庭，却以普通学生和住户的身份参与景太郎一行人的生活。她天真直接、精力旺盛，和素子、奈留等性格各异的女生相处时，经常成为推动群体活动的人。
traits: 与景太郎等人共同生活

source.description: An immigrant who resides in the Hinata house in the town of Hinata hot springs. She is a very energetic and innovative youth that is always doing something and can manufacture the most amazing things at a whim. Let's not mention her room, it's a jungle in there!!

characters.name: 纹尾
characters.description: 纹尾是日向庄的住户和自由撰稿人，常被朋友称为“狐狸”。她喜欢享受轻松生活，写作工作却经常拖延，因此会想办法从身边人那里占些便宜。纹尾性格机灵，擅长观察住户关系，也常设计玩笑或小把戏。她与奈留关系亲近，既会推波助澜地撮合朋友，也会让景太郎陷入窘境，是日向庄里成熟又懒散的气氛担当。

source.description: She is a scheming freelance writer (and is conspicuous in her lack of writing). A model example of a parasite single, Kitsune lives to enjoy the easy life, and frequently scams others by any means possible. She is frequently drunk, and bottles can be found hidden all over her room. Her greatest joy seems to be teasing Keitaro, even though she clearly cares for him. She is a school friend of Naru and tries her best (or worst) to make Keitaro and Naru get married. In order to maintain her finances, she often bets on horse races. In the anime, Kitsune speaks with an Osaka accent, which seems to imply a connection between her sly, money-minded personality and a common stereotype about people who hail from that region.

characters.name: 濑田纪康
characters.description: 濑田纪康是东京大学毕业的考古学教授，专攻考古学，外形和行动方式常让人联想到冒险家。他过去也曾经历多年备考，因此能理解景太郎对进入东大的执着。濑田知识丰富，却经常因为粗心而制造意外；他与景太郎和日向庄的住户们保持联系，也把考古调查带入日常生活。作为学者和冒险者，他的出现让作品从公寓喜剧延伸到旅行与遗迹探索。
traits: 外形和行动带有冒险家气质
参与日向庄周边人物的冒险

source.description: A Tokyo University graduate and professor who specialises in archaeology, appearing to be a parody of Indiana Jones. Like Keitaro, he was a third-year ronin. He's clumsy (especially with women), a terrible driver (his arrival often heralded by his van crashing down from the sky), and an exceptionally skilled martial artist, all partly due to his complete lack of self-preservation.

characters.name: 莎拉·麦克杜格尔
characters.description: 莎拉·麦克杜格尔是来自美国加利福尼亚州的九岁女孩，也是濑田收养的女儿。她年纪虽小，却很有主见，初到日本时尤其喜欢捉弄景太郎，让他难以招架。随着在日向庄和周围伙伴间生活，她逐渐展现依赖与亲近的一面，也与奈留等人建立起联系。莎拉的调皮常制造喜剧场面，同时呈现她在陌生环境中寻找归属感的过程。
traits: 在相处中逐渐融入伙伴群

source.description: A nine year old American from California and Seta's adopted daughter. She initially delights in making Keitaro's life miserable, however, like most of the girls in the story, she eventually warms to him, even if she still calls him a dork.

characters.name: 阿玛拉·苏
characters.description: 阿玛拉·苏是可萝拉的姐姐，也属于莫鲁莫鲁王国的王族。她和妹妹一样被称为魔法少女，拥有不同于普通日向庄住户的王室背景。阿玛拉比可萝拉更成熟，熟悉家族与王国事务，同时对表亲兰巴抱有爱慕之情。她来到日本后参与妹妹周围的生活，也让日向庄的日常与莫鲁莫鲁王国的婚姻、继承传统产生联系。
traits: 与妹妹一同生活在日本
因王族关系卷入婚姻与继承话题

source.description: Kaolla Su's older sister. Both she and her sister are magical girls, and both are members of the royal family of the kingdom of Molmol. Amalla has been in love with cousin Crown Prince Lamba Lu for a long time, but has never admitted her feelings to him

characters.name: 兰巴·鲁
characters.description: 兰巴·鲁被可萝拉和阿玛拉称作“哥哥”，实际上是两人的表兄弟；三人从小一起长大，因此关系像亲兄妹。他是莫鲁莫鲁王国的国王，需要承担王室职责和传统。兰巴与阿玛拉之间的感情也与王族婚姻习俗相连，使他不只是日向庄来访者，更是把日本日常与异国王室生活连接起来的人物。面对两姐妹和景太郎等人，他常以王族身份处理事务。
traits: 可萝拉与阿玛拉的表兄弟
从小与两姐妹像兄妹般长大
将王国生活带入日向庄故事线

source.description: "Brother" to Amalla and Kaolla. In reality, he is a cousin of theirs, but they have grown up as siblings. He is the king of their nation, and in the tradition of their people, he has to serve in the military for a period of time. Before that happens, he is required to marry. Once when Su was a very young girl he promised to marry her, but then he realises that she only sees him as a brother, whereas Amalla is in love with him

characters.name: 浦岛遥
characters.description: 浦岛遥是日向庄的经营者之一，与景太郎有亲属关系。她经常叼着香烟，性格火爆直率，身体素质和格斗能力也相当出众。遥负责处理日向庄的日常事务，熟悉住户们的性格与生活状况，遇到问题时会直接出面管理。她看起来严厉，却会在关键时刻照顾景太郎和其他晚辈，是公寓里兼具长辈、管理者与吐槽者身份的人。
traits: 与浦岛景太郎有亲属关系
管理日向庄与咖啡店事务

source.description: Haruka is Keitaro Urashima's "aunt". Haruka is constantly seen smoking a cigarette. Like Naru, she has a fiery temper (and great physical prowess to match), which she hides under a calm, detached exterior. Once a fellow student and love interest of Seta, she became fed up with his obsession for archeology, his tendency to get into trouble, and his apparent obliviousness to her feelings and left him.

characters.name: 温泉蛋
characters.description: 温泉蛋是日向庄住户们熟悉的一只会飞乌龟，也常被亲切地叫作小玉。它由睦美送给景太郎，名字带有“温泉蛋”的玩笑意味。温泉蛋能够飞行，常在住户旅行和日常活动中出现，成为陪伴大家的动物伙伴。它的出现也让景太郎与睦美相识的经历留在公寓生活中，时常为群像故事带来轻松的插曲。
traits: 连接景太郎与睦美的相识经历

source.description: Tamago Onsen lit. "Hot Springs Egg" or also called Tama-chan is a flying turtle in the Love Hina series. Tama-chan was given to Keitaro by Mutsumi as a gift. Keitaro points out that the turtle is male, but the girls are convinced he is a 'she' and so 'he' is referred to as 'she' throughout the manga. She is an 'onsen kame' or hot-springs turtle, and like others of her species. Su, Mutsumi, Seta, and (later in the series) Keitaro appear to have the ability to speak with Tama-chan, and Su occasionally develops the urge to eat her, though sometimes it is just to tease Shinobu (in the manga, it is said on a side note that Su drops this habit in order to wait for Tama-chan to reproduce).

characters.name: 成濑川梅
characters.description: 成濑川梅是奈留的妹妹，曾到日向庄探望姐姐并接触景太郎等住户。她和奈留在性格与生活方式上有所不同，却很关心姐姐的近况，也会对姐姐的同居生活感到好奇。梅的出现让故事暂时从日向庄住户关系转向奈留的家庭生活，使观众看到奈留作为姐姐的一面。她与景太郎和其他女生互动时，也常为公寓日常带来新的误会和话题。

source.description: Mei-chan is Naru's younger sister.

characters.name: 青山鹤子
characters.description: 青山鹤子是素子的姐姐，也是负责守护青山家神鸣流剑术传统的人。她行事严肃稳重，把家族荣誉和剑术传承看得很重，因此会关注素子的修行与选择。鹤子并不直接管理日向庄，却会因妹妹的生活和剑术训练来到她身边。她既是素子敬重的长辈，也是促使素子思考自己是否要遵循家族安排的重要人物。
traits: 负责守护青山家的剑术传统
代表传统对妹妹提出要求

source.description:
Tsuruko is Motoko's older sister and the one currently entrusted with the keeping of their family's Shinmeiryuu tradition. She is not active in running the school, having given up the life of the sword for marriage, and it is her duty to hand the school over to Motoko's care when the time comes.    

Though Motoko has lived in fear of Tsuruko for years, Tsuruko has Motoko's best interests at heart and her only real wish is for her sister to be happy on whatever path she chooses to walk. Unfortunately, she has a habit of trying to kill her sister when she lies to her (when she tried to take Motoko back to Kyoto and, to prevent this, she pretended to be engaged with Keitaro) or does not tell her the full details of a situation (when Motoko omitted that she flunked the Todai admittance exam).  Like her sister, her sword techniques are centered around the destruction of evil, using ki attacks with her slash, some of them hurting only evil beings, but mostly slashing through rocks, people or larger objects.

characters.name: 坂田健太郎
characters.description: 坂田健太郎曾经喜欢成濑川奈留，并一度成为浦岛景太郎的竞争者。为了追求奈留，他花掉不少钱财，结果在经济上遭遇挫折，却仍然没有马上放弃。他的执着常让自己陷入滑稽处境，也让景太郎不得不面对情敌带来的压力。坂田参与日向庄周围的校园和社交事件，后来逐渐接受奈留与景太郎之间的关系。
traits: 一度成为景太郎的竞争者
为追求奈留花费大量金钱
在喜剧事件中反复出现

source.description: Kentaro had a crush on Naru. Originally Keitaro's rival for Narusegawa, he eventually loses all of his money in his pursuit of her. He remained fairly tenacious for a time, but eventually gave up after getting deep into debt with the Hinata Inn. Haruka let him try to work off his debts at a very low rate of pay; from that point on, Kentaro became an occasional background character and plot device. He also tends to make jokes at the stereotype of the anime's genre, and occasionally breaks the fourth wall.

characters.name: 灰谷真之
characters.description: 灰谷真之是景太郎的儿时朋友，与白井功明经常一起出现。两人都喜欢拿景太郎的学习和恋爱进展开玩笑，灰谷比白井高一些，也较早进入大学。虽然他常以损友姿态调侃景太郎，但仍关心老朋友的生活变化，并会在需要时提供同龄人的建议。灰谷的出现让作品呈现景太郎在日向庄之外的朋友圈，也衬托出他面对大学考试时的落差与压力。
traits: 喜欢拿景太郎的学业开玩笑
和朋友一起调侃景太郎
关注景太郎的备考生活
在喜剧场景中充当损友

source.description: Masayuki is one of Keitaro's childhood friends, and is (apart from a few physical differences) almost exactly like Shirai. He is taller and enters a university before Shirai or Keitaro.

characters.name: 萌
characters.description: 萌是一具外表像少女的自动人偶，制造时间早于故事一百多年，曾在一九〇〇年的巴黎世界博览会上展出，之后被东京帝国大学购入。她的双腿曾经损坏，不能正常行动；浦岛家族的祖辈曾答应修好她，却一直没有完成。萌与日向庄及浦岛家族的旧约有关，在现代剧情中成为景太郎和伙伴们追查往事、尝试修复的重要对象。
traits: 一百多年前制造的自动人偶
在一九〇〇年巴黎世博会展出
后来由东京帝国大学购入
与浦岛家族的约定有关
是日向庄往事中的重要物件角色

source.description: Moé-chan is an automaton with broken legs, built more than 100 years ago and bought by Tokyo Imperial University while she was on display at the Paris World's Fair in 1900. Urashima Keisuke purchased her from the university in hopes of repairing her.    Moé-chan was a great friend of Keisuke, Granny Hina's father and great-grandfather to Keitaro and Haruka. Keisuke had promised to fix Moé-chan's legs; but like Keitaro, Keisuke had a poor memory and eventually forgot about Moé-chan. Keitaro would later make the same promise to fix her. With the help of the Hinata residents, particularly Kaolla's help, he ultimately fulfilled his promise and Moé-chan was able to walk again.

characters.name: 浦岛日向
characters.description: 浦岛日向是日向庄最初的经营者，也是景太郎的长辈。她退休后决定环游世界，把日向庄托付给景太郎照看，因此后者才搬进旅馆并承担管理责任。日向熟悉旅馆的历史和住户关系，虽然经常不在日本，仍通过自己的决定影响年轻人的生活。她的托付构成故事的起点，也让日向庄成为不同背景角色共同生活的场所。
traits: 把日向庄托付给景太郎
以长辈身份影响年轻角色
代表日向庄过去的经营传统

source.description: Hinata Urashima also known as Grandma Hina, is the original manager of Hinata. Upon retiring so she could travel the world she entrusted Keitaro with looking over the Hinata Inn.    In the manga, Grandma Hina knew all along that Naru was the girl Keitaro promised to go to Tokyo U with. She also knew the location of the Liddo-Kun shaped time capsule Keitaro, Naru, and Mutsumi buried beneath the sandbox when they were children.[1]    Despite only appearing briefly in the manga and anime, her visits and actions have a profound effect on everyone, especially Naru and Keitaro.    Source: Wikipedia.

characters.name: 松本幸代
characters.description: 松本幸代是青山素子粉丝俱乐部的成员，经常和俱乐部伙伴一起关注素子的校园活动。她留着短棕发，习惯称呼素子为“素子前辈”，把对方视作值得支持的剑道高手。幸代参与校园应援和粉丝俱乐部的日常，也在特别篇中出现。她不是日向庄的核心住户，却补充了素子在学校里受到同学崇拜的一面。
traits: 青山素子粉丝俱乐部成员
关注剑道部与素子的活动
与粉丝俱乐部伙伴往来

source.description: She is part of Motoko's fan club. The fanclub always refers to  Motoko Aoyama as Motoko-senpai.     Sachiyo is the one with the short brown hair.     In Love Hina Spring Special she is the one who asks Shinobu about the boy who confessed his love to her.

characters.name: 前原康治
characters.description: 前原康治是动画版中出现的角色，也是前原忍的父亲。夫妻决定离婚后，他希望争取女儿的监护权，忍的母亲则反对将女儿交给他照顾。这场家庭争执让忍的校园生活短暂受到影响，也使奈留和朋友们注意到她的处境。康治没有长期参与日向庄故事线，但他的出现补充了忍的家庭背景，并推动她与同学建立更深的联系。
traits: 只在动画版出现的角色
在夫妻离婚时争取女儿监护权
推动忍与同学建立关系

source.description: He is only seen in the anime. In episode 2, during the couple's divorce, he seeks to have custody of his daughter Shinobu Maehara but her mother Mrs. Maehara accuses him of infidelity, which he denies vehemently.     In the Christmas special, he appears and gives Kaolla Su and Sarah McDougal a taxi ride for free because he has a daughter their age, and he didn't want her to be stranded like they were. He works as a taxi driver.

characters.name: 太地亚纪子
characters.description: 太地亚纪子是前原忍的朋友，也认识可萝拉·苏。她在校园生活中与忍相遇，之后又出现在圣诞特别篇等故事里，参与年轻角色的日常活动。亚纪子性格较容易受到惊吓，但仍会跟随朋友们一起经历旅行和聚会。她不常住在日向庄，却能让忍和可萝拉在公寓之外拥有自己的同学交往圈，补充了作品的校园群像。
traits: 在校园生活中与忍相遇
参与同学间的日常活动
与日向庄女生保持联系

source.description: She meets Shinobu Maehara in episode 2, and reappears again in episode 13, the Christmas special and Spring Special. Her other best friend is Kaolla Su.     She tends to be easily talked into doing stupid things, and sometimes does foolish things.  However, she is a good friend to those she is close to.

characters.name: 浦岛景介
characters.description: 浦岛景介是浦岛日向的父亲，也是景太郎与加奈子的曾祖父。他曾经答应修好自动人偶萌，却一直没有兑现承诺，这件旧事影响了萌在现代的处境。景介与日向庄的历史和浦岛家族的往事相连，虽然并非当代住户，仍通过家族记忆推动景太郎一行人关注萌的来历与修复。这个角色把日向庄的当下生活和家族过去连接起来。
traits: 景太郎与加奈子的曾祖父
与自动人偶萌的维修约定有关
以回忆和家族旧事进入故事

source.description: Granny Hina's father and great-grandfather to Keitaro and Kanako.    He made a promise to fix  Moe-Chan and never got around to it. His descendant  Keitaro Urashima a finally completed that promise in episode 20 of the Love Hina anime. His daughter is Hinata Urashima and his great-grand-children are Keitaro Urashima and Haruka Urashima.
